adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. A template string is always a non-empty string (e.g., `"undefined: undefined"`), so the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback is effectively unreachable. This also surfaces raw `err.data?.code` and passes `err.message` through `t()` even when it may not be a translation key (e.g., TRPC/Zod messages), producing confusing output.
